name: Storybook Village — connected street and house joins
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: A cluster of cream-plaster/carved-timber houses with steep blue-violet slate gables, dormers, chimneys, arched doors/windows, rose boxes and an arched street passage between attached buildings. Miniature isometric suggests a compact joined settlement, not isolated identical cottages. Hidden layout inference: A winding cobbled lane enters through the source arched passage, opens into a small shared flower court, and branches into two lanes toward windmill/forest. Keep taller gabled corner houses as markers and quieter small cottages along edges; rear gardens connect via footpaths without becoming giant plazas. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "B12-CITY-001 — Storybook Village — connected street and house joins". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Existing cottage kits cover forest adaptation, not original attached-village street buildings

Show rear and roof/street contacts; roof corners/door placement follow original village. No huge palace turrets.
